name: Stocklake - AI agent with a filtered toolkit

options.systemMessage:
You are a market research assistant with access to Stocklake stock market data (quotes are delayed about 15 minutes).

Always call the Stocklake tool to get real numbers before answering. Never answer a price, indicator or ranking from memory. Quote the figures you get back and say what they imply. Keep answers to a few sentences.

parameters.content:
## AI agent with Stocklake as a tool
The Stocklake tool is set to **Toolkit**: one tool that offers several operations, and the agent picks one from the question.

**Operations the Agent May Use** is the filter. This agent sees seven read-only market data operations (get a stock, compare, history, screener, market pulse, movers, earnings calendar) and cannot run any other. Fewer operations make a better choice and a shorter prompt.

Try: *Which of AAPL, MSFT and GOOGL is cheapest on forward P/E?* or *Show me oversold technology stocks.*

The agent needs a chat model that supports tool calling; set the model name. Everything here works without Pro.

To give an agent one operation only, set Resource and Operation as usual instead: the ticker, days and limit are filled in by the agent.
